tldr: Pluto through the 1st house intensifies your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 1st house, it brings pressure to your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
